tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Adeline asked me to meet her in her office to get a better understanding of the inner workings of the government.
Adeline's office in the Manor House
Adeline asked me to meet her in her office. She wants my help with an important choice as "an average Mistrian".
Adeline's office in the Manor House

Option 1:
Wood (25)
Stone (25)
Option 2:
Big Cookie (1)
Adeline asked me to come along for her next inspection of Mistria. We'll start from the Request Board.
Adeline asked me to join her for tea. I hope she takes the time to actually relax...
Adeline's office in the Manor House
Adeline said she's been craving Lemon Pie. Anything to help her out!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
This time of year always makes me think of my mother's favorite flower, heather.
Could someone gather a few bunches for me?

I was planning to make some tea with lemon, but I'm short on lemons!
If you have an extra one, can you bring it to me? I'll teach you my recipe!

Would someone bring me some pineshrooms?
I'm really craving a nostalgic winter treat. If you don't mind bringing me some, I'll teach you how to make it!

My father, Baron Wiscar, has requested I send him something that he can give to the King.
I can't think of anything more suitable than a Silver Sword!

It's that time of year! I need to write a report on Mistria's spring crop yield.
Could you bring me a turnip to inspect?
Request for an Iron Watering Can
Our Iron Watering Can seems to have been misplaced, can I request someone craft me a new one?
Despite filling out the proper forms, we've had a request by the Capital for a Mistril Ingot to confirm that it's a new metal.

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Seeking help to unload supplies for the relief effort, paying 200t. Come talk to me.
Balor wants to give me advice on the items I'm shipping. I should go meet him in the Inn to hear him out.

Balor asked me to join him for a meal at the Inn.
Business must be good!
Balor asked me to meet him in his room at the Inn for a meal.

tables.title: Requests
rows: Mistria's apples are second to none, I'd like to request one freshly picked from the tree.

A trading partner wants to see the quality of the new copper coming out of the Mines.
Could I get a Copper Ingot?

The mines were once famous for the quality of their emeralds.
If you happen to find any, I'd pay handsomely.
I have it on good authority that the Mine is producing Gold Ore again. I'm paying handsomely to have some of that ore come directly to me.

I realize this is a big ask, but I have a customer who's willing to pay well for a ruby.
If you can get your hands on one, we can split the profits.
A friend of a friend has a horse that needs to be in tiptop shape for a race. I've been asked to procure Ultimate Large Animal Feed. You'll be well compensated for assisting me.
I'd quite like to get my hands on a Pink Diamond, if any are to be found in Mistria.
I'd like to request a bottle of Uncommon Pheromone. If it works on bugs, maybe it could have applications in the perfume industry.
Completed: Maple's Request for Common Pheromone

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Caldarus asked me to join him at his temple for a meal. What could he want to speak about?

tables.title: Requests
rows: I'd like to request a Dog Treat for the Bathhouse owner.
I had some Fried Rice at the Inn which I found to be quite enjoyable! I would like to request more from another chef to see how it differs.
It's quite the walk to the ocean from my home. I'd like to request a Lobster from an angler.
I would like to request a dish called "Monster Mash". My own attempts at creating it have been less than successful.
Could I request a fresh Pumpkin Pie?
May I request a Sushi Platter?

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Celine has a question about a flower that she hopes I can help her with.
Celine asked me to meet her at her cottage. The mystery seed hasn't sprouted yet and she wants my insight into what could possibly make this seed grow.
Celine says the she can't get the sprout to grow any more and wants to brainstorm what to do. Is there something special it needs?
Celine asked me to join her for a picnic! She wants to meet at her cottage first.
Celine said she's been craving a Spring Salad. Anything to help her out!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
I've saved up for a new Copper Shovel, but the Blacksmith's is so busy, I don't want to trouble them.
Could someone help me out?

I've read that ground up Coral can be good for growing certain types of plants.
Can someone bring me some?

Can you bring me some fennel if you find any growing east of town?
I'll teach you how to make a spring salad in return!

Would someone bring me some sod and peat for a potting soil mix I'm testing?
I'll share some fresh flowers from my garden in return!

Current Season: Spring
Obtained: Worn Pickaxe

The Codex Mistria has some very interesting flowers it says are native to the region including a "Shadow Flower".
I'd like to have one to see how it grows!

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Darcy asked me to meet her at the Sleeping Dragon Inn to try her new coffee blends.

tables.title: Requests
rows: Valen told me that Mistria has a tea I've never even heard of! Could I request a cup of Spirit Mushroom Tea, please?
I love working with regional ingredients, could I request 3 Walnuts?
Terithia told me that Mistria has Coconuts at the beach, but I haven't had the time to get out there myself. Could I request 3 Coconuts?
I've always enjoyed Peaches, and I thought it'd be fun to request some to experiment with in my drinks!
I've really been craving a Pomegranate for some reason. Could anyone help me out?

Current Season: Winter
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
Has anyone heard of Legendary Honey? Supposedly even a single drop of it makes any dessert taste amazing! I gotta have a jar!
Have anyone ever seen a Spell Fruit? Celine told me about them from that old book of hers. I'd love to try one!

tables.title: Requests
rows: Celine read me a story about a princess befriending woodland creatures with a song. I can't sing, but I bet I could bribe them! Can I get some Acorns to help build my woodland army?

URGENT: I need some chestnuts!
Please bring me some as soon as possible! I'll trade you an apple!

Every fantasy story I read has a talking frog in it! There's too many in the Eastern Road's pond for me to check them all.
Help me start my big adventure!
Could someone get me a Crocus? Please?

Mister March said if I could bring him iron, he'd make me a sword!
I've been saving my allowance for forever to post this!
Olric told me that Obsidian is cooled down lava! I want one! Someone get me one!

Mom said I shouldn't keep catching snails to bring home, but she didn't say I couldn't put up a request for one!
Please help, I just need one more to complete the whole set!
Could someone make me a Cherry Tart, fast? It's life or death!

tables.title: Requests
rows: Dozy asked me to request someone bring him a "Tidestone" he thinks it'll be a real draw at the Bathhouse.

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Eiland asked me to meet him at the Manor House. He wants to show me an "interesting" historical site on the grounds.
Eiland asked me to meet him at the Western Ruins to look for more clues and possibly more Dragonsworn Armor.
Eiland says that the search for the Dragonsworn Armor has taken an unexpected turn. I should meet him at the manor.
Eiland needs more time to find a lead on the Dragonsworn armor, but wants go for a walk in the Deep Woods. Maybe walking will clear his mind?

tables.title: Requests
rows:
I'm craving something sweet!
If you bring me some wild berries, I'll teach you how to make berries and cream!

Errol suggested that more protein in my diet could help with my excavation work.
May I request three eggs?

Has anyone seen any Moon Fruit? They're quite hard to come by, but can be foraged around Mistria this time of year.
Please bring me one and I'll share a wonderful recipe for them!

I'm seeking some shards as part of my archaeological research. They can often be unearthed at dig sites!
If you come across any, could you bring me some?
Can someone bring me a strawberry? I'll share my recipe for strawberry shortcake as a reward!

Would someone please bring me a strawberry?
I'm happy to share my recipe for strawberries and cream in return!

A fellow researcher has written to me with an unusual request for a Striped Bass from Mistria.
Could I prevail on someone to help me by catching one?
I recently read a treatise on Puddings, and now I can't stop thinking about them. May I request one?
I'm quite fond of Pumpkin Pie, and would like to request a Pumpkin for one!

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Elsie asked me to meet her in her room at the Manor House to discuss her memoirs.
Elsie's room in the Manor House

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Could someone drop off some blackberries, please?
I just love blackberry jam but I'm nearly out. If you can bring me some, I'll teach you how to make your own!

Would someone be a dear and fetch me an Orange? I need to make a fresh batch of my famous Marmalade.
I'd be happy to reveal the recipe to you in exchange.

A personal friend in the Capital, who happens to be a rather famous jeweler, has been complaining about the silver shortage.
Please bring me a bar so I can make a gift of it.
If you wouldn't mind bringing me one of those lovely flowers that grows by the Western Ruins, I can provide you with seeds to grow more.

There are many ways to use the Mistrian Wild Berry, but in my opinion there's no finer way than in a fresh scone!
Bring me some wild berries and let me share the recipe with you.
Could someone bring me a dozen Roses? I quite like the flower, but I'm not much of a fan of the actual picking, too many thorns.
I'm quite partial to Blueberry Jam, could I request a few jars?

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: I've got an old chest gathering dust at the museum, and I just can't get it open. Could someone lend me a hand?

tables.title: Requests
rows: If someone would be so kind as to bring me some wild berries for my snack, I would be in your debt.

Years ago Terithia showed me how to make the most delectable Clam Chowder, but I'm too old to be diving for the Clam I need off the coast.
Help a fellow out?

Armor styles have changed greatly throughout Aldaria's history.
I would like to request Iron Armor crafted in the modern style for my research.

I'm quite fond of Perch Risotto, but lack the fish.
If anyone is fishing in the river on a rainy day, please keep an eye out for it and bring one to me for the recipe.

The Capital Museum has requested a Tilapia, but my skills do not lie in fishing.
There is a generous reimbursement if you can help.
I'm afraid my patch of garden has become a breakfast spot to some very unruly birds. May I request a Scarecrow so my vegetables remain unharmed?
May I request a brace of Pears? They make an excellent snack.
There is a very old sword made of an unidentified type of metal in the Museum's backroom. I would like to request a Corrupted Mistril Sword to compare the two.
I have a dear friend who loves to fish, and am hoping to procure her some Uncommon Bait as a gift.
Completed: Terithia's Request for Common Bait

tables.title: Important Quests
rows:
Can't thank you enough for your work on the mill, [Player]!
If you've got some time, come on over to my place. I'll put on the kettle and we can chat about ranching and raising animals!
Letter from Hayden, after completing Story Quest "The Mill Restoration Project"
Complete Story Quest "The Mill Restoration Project"
Meet Hayden at his house west of your farm.

Hay (10)
Grass Seed (10)
Tea with Lemon (1)

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Hayden has invited me to a get together at his place.
Hayden has some extra feed to give me and wants me to meet him at his farm. I wonder how Henrietta's doing...
Hayden says he has a day planed to help socialize Henrietta. Does the General Store let chickens inside... ?
Hayden asked me to come over so that we could spend some time together. I wonder what food he's making...

tables.title: Requests
rows:
I have a theory I'd like to test, but I need some help!
Can someone bring me a baked potato? I think I can improve the recipe!
Could I request some Thorn Vine? Could be a good deterrent to keep pests out of my field!
I'd like to give my cows a little extra hay for being so good. I can swap it for some of their milk!

Could someone craft some wood fencing for me?
Henrietta's been testing the integrity of my current enclosure and it's simply not meeting her standards.
Henrietta was a big help with farm chores the other day and deserves a special treat. Could someone bring me a bag of Ultimate Small Animal Feed?
Could I request some fresh Peas? Henrietta's a big fan!
Anyone got any spare Blackberries? They make great feed for my animals!

Current Season: Fall
Obtained: Any Animal

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Hemlock asked me to meet him at the Sleeping Dragon Inn to help plan a date night for Josephine.

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Luc's been asking me to get a friend for his caterpillar but I'm not sure where to get one.
Can someone bring me one? I'll repay you with a bite to eat!
I need a catfish for a dish we're making at the inn! If you bring me one, I'll teach you my recipe!

Current Season: Spring
Obtained: Worn Fishing Rod

This crisp weather has me in the mood for Roasted Chestnuts!
Bring me some and I'll share my recipe with you.
When we have a really spicy dish I like to keep plenty of Rice on the table to help cut the heat for the kids. Can I request a couple of bags?

A friend went out of the way to do me a favor and I'd like to show him how much I appreciated it.
Could you find me a Sapphire?

We're placing an order for new blankets for the inn soon, and I think it'd make them extra special to be made of wool from Mistrian sheep.
I'll need half a dozen!
Hard to keep plants around the Inn, since Luc keeps making them into his bug's habitats. Can I request a Potted Plant so he can have a designated place for them?
Things around here are too busy to go foraging myself, so can someone please hunt down some Wild Grapes for me? Try the Narrows!
I'd like to surprise someone with a Copper Net! Can anyone make one for me?

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Winter's here and that means Beets!
I'd like to request the freshest, most mouthwatering Beet you can find!
Request for Bell Berry Bakewell Tart
Could someone whip me up a Bell Berry Bakewell Tart, now that the Deep Woods are opened back up?

Would someone bring me some tomatoes?
I could really go for some nice cool gazpacho! I'll make enough for both of us!
Can I get someone to fish me up a Goby? They're good luck!
Can someone fish me up a Lake Trout from the Deep Woods?
Now, I love to whittle, but I've been thinking of expanding out into other materials. Could I request a Monster Horn to practice on?
I'm requesting a fresh snacking Cabbage!
Looking for the freshest, most delicious Cauliflower in Mistria!
You wouldn't believe how hard it is to get Sugar Cane in Mistria! Could I request one?

tables.title: Important Quests
rows:
On your own for the first time and unsure how to feed yourself?
Come to the Sleeping Dragon Inn for a free cooking class with Josephine! Learn the ins and outs of cooking!
Meet Josephine at the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows:
I'm having trouble with a stray cat. I just cannot get the poor dear to come out of the stables.
Come talk to me and we'll come up with a plan!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
You'd be amazed at how much ice we need to stock up on to keep our drinks cold and our food fresh!
Would you mind helping out?

We could use some fresh Rooster Feathers to refill our guest pillows.
Could someone help us out?
If it's not too much trouble, could someone bring me some fresh salmon? Our last shipment was a little short.

I like to keep plenty of Trail Mix on hand for the kids, but they sure eat a lot of it! Can someone mix some more up for me? You'll need Wild Berries and Water Chestnuts from the Narrows to make it!
Feel free to use the kitchen at the inn.
I've heard of something called "Crystal Berries" that grow in Mistria, but I haven't been able to find any! Can I request some? I'd love to see what I can bake with them!
Maple keeps asking for Noodles, but then tells me "not these Noodles, the other ones!" I'm at my wit's end, can someone bring me a plateful to try to appease my little princess?
Could I request some Dill? Can't make good Crab Cakes without it!
Seems to me I'm always running out of Chili Peppers! I'd like to request a few.

tables.title: Important Quests
rows: Attractive and extremely talented bathhouse owner seeks a gopher to find and hand over a Lilac.

Bring a lilac to Juniper.
Lilac (1)

Heath and Stamina full recovery
5 free The Bathhouse visits
Weather Crystal Ball

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows:
Come and get your free health tonic at Juniper's Bathhouse!
Clears your pores, freshens your breath, and side effects are minimal.
Available while supplies last.
Juniper wants to test another potion on me. I should go to the bathhouse before she tests it on someone else.
Juniper asked me to come and help her with some "menial errands". How does Dozy put up with it...
Juniper asked me to bring her a Breath of Flame flower for a new bath infusion. Another errand?
Juniper said she's been craving Pizza. Anything to help her out!

tables.title: Requests
rows: You won't find a more comfortable stuffing for a chair than Capybara Bristles, which is why I require some.

Rumor has it that crystals of marvelous quality can be found below the mines.
I would be willing to pay top tesserae for some.
Dozy likes a duck egg in his food every now and then, bring one to me.

Eiland claims he saw a "mystical, ethereal flower that seemed out of a bygone era" at the Western Ruins.
I've got better things to do then hunt for it, but if you find it, bring it to me.

I've recently seen a curious new item called "monster powder" on the market.
I would like to investigate its uses. Bring some to me.

Unlocked The Mines
Obtained: Monster Powder
Important Request for a Moon Fruit

I had no idea Mistria was so far out in the country that I'd need to bake my own Moon Fruit Cake.
Luckily Dozy has chef training. Would someone bring me a Moon Fruit?
I require a red toadstool for something I'm working on. I will not be elaborating.

I keep seeing folks enjoying Water Chestnuts in all the ways but the best way- deep fried.
Bring me some and I'll enlighten you to the recipe.
Seeking a Monster Core to help settle an academic debate.
Dozy quite enjoys a raw Carrot as a treat, and I'd like for him to have the very best. Gather me a few, or, uh grow them? I'm not sure.
Requesting a Night Queen flower. I need one for my work, but apparently they're quite rare, so I'm prepared to pay well.
I've had no luck hunting down a particularly rare bug, so I'd like to request a bottle of Rare Pheromone to assist.
Looking for Voidite. It's a theoretical "mineral" formed in unusual circumstances.

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Would someone bring me some coconuts from the beach?
This weather calls for a nice cold drink. Bring me some and I'll fix us up some coconut milk!

It was hard enough to get glass before the earthquake, now it's near impossible!
I'll pay good money to whoever can find us some.
Can someone bring me some wood to help us restock? I'll pay a fair price!
I don't like dipping into the shop's supplies for personal projects. Can I request 5 Sap for my woodworking?
Could I get a bowl of Tomato Soup? I've had it at the Inn, I've had it at the Capital, I want to try everyone's take on it!
Need someone who has got the know-how to get me some Rare Bait!
Completed: Errol's Request for Uncommon Bait
I don't know if I'm just getting older, or the trees are getting tougher, but I'd like to request a Silver Axe to even the odds!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Rabbit Wool is essential for high quality garments, and one of my preferred materials to work in.
Please bring some to me!
A customer of mine wants something unusual and daring to offset his new outfit. I'd like to request a Monster Fang to help in my design.

Unlocked The Mines
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
I would like to request an Apple Pie, if someone would be so kind!

Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
Current Day: Saturday
Current Season: Fall
I've heard rumors of Mistria's rarest flower, the Middlemist. Can anyone find one for me?

Current Season: Spring
Reached Year 2
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
Could I request a few sprigs of Holly to decorate my booth with?

Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
Current Season: Winter

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows:
I believe I have discovered a way to attract a never before seen insect species.
Can I count on you to assist me? If so, meet me inside the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

tables.title: Requests
rows: I've heard there's an amazing beetle found in the Mines... Please, I must have it for my collection! I'll trade for it!
Have you ever heard of the Dragon Horn Beetle? I have! But I haven't been able to find one in the Deep Woods yet. Please help!

Mom says I can't keep trying to catch a Pond Skater, cause I keep falling into the water when I miss!
Can someone help me catch one?
Could someone bring me a Crab? From the beach?
Mom says I can't eat a big chunk of Cheese as a meal, but I can't think of any scientific reason why not. Could I request some Cheese, for science?
Can someone help me catch a Singing Katydid? I want to put on a concert for all of my other bugs!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Miss Terithia told me there's a fish called a Mullet, and I don't believe it!
I'd cough up my favorite snack if someone proves me wrong!

If I'm going to become queen someday, I need to get more comfortable giving orders...
Bring me a pretty seashell... please!
Did you know that pearls come from oysters? I didn't! I can't afford a pearl, but I can request a Freshwater Oyster!
Did you know the Princess of Aldaria is really into flowers? It'd be cool to have a flower to talk to her about. Help me find a Temple Flower!
Sunflowers are so pretty, and they have so many seeds! I bet with just one I could make a whole FIELD of Sunflowers! Can I have one whole Sunflower, please?

Luc really likes finding new bugs, and he told me that the Pheromone stuff the Terrarium makes helps a lot!
So I want to request a Common Pheromone to give to him!

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: March asked to meet at the Blacksmiths without delay. No further explanation provided.
Olric asked me to come help him and March out with their work. March said my blacksmithing is improving but Olric wasn't supposed to tell me that...
March asked me in a short letter to stop by if I wanted part-time work. How loquacious...

tables.title: Requests
rows: Terithia told me a legend of an Armored Bass, a fish that grows its own armor. Willing to pay well to see if it really exists.
I need some copper ore and I need it soon. If you can manage it, I'll pay you for it.
I need a freshwater eel. Bring one to me if you want to know how to make a grilled eel rice bowl.

Recipe: Grilled Eel Rice Bowl
20 Renown

Let's see how your blacksmithing is coming along, bring me an Iron Ingot.
Yes, [Player]. I'm talking to you.

I want to try forging something with these "monster shells" I've been seeing around.
I don't care to know where they come from, just bring me some.

Unlocked The Mines
Obtained: Monster Shell

The prices for importing silver into Mistria are outrageous.
Dig some up for me, I don't need much.
Can I request a Shipping Bin? We're running out of room at the Blacksmith's.
Eiland mentioned an ancient technique called "Dragon Forging" but couldn't remember where he read it. I'm requesting a Dragon Forged Bracelet, but I'm not sure it exists.
I've heard there's a new type of metal ore coming out of the mines. Could I request some Mistril Ore?

tables.title: Requests
rows: I could use some horse hair for my reupholstery work, please and thank you.
Can I request a Hay Bale? They've got a lot of design potential!
My horse Swiftwind is a big fan of Watermelon, I'd like to request one as a treat for him.
A friend of mine says that Mistrian Fiddleheads are the best around, and asked if I could gather one for her. But I don't even know what they look like. Little help?

Current Season: Spring
Reached Year 2
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
I know it isn't easy to get a hold of, but if anyone has Hard Wood they can sell me it'd be big help!

Current Season: Fall
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows:
The Saturday Market Committee Election is upon us again! I'm seeking re-election as Chief Councilor and I'd love your help, [Player].
Meet me at the town square.

tables.title: Requests
rows:
I need to get my hands on some clay so that Dell can finish her "art project".
Apparently she needs it to make a legendary sword?
I'm looking for a unique gift for Celine. I know it's a longshot, but can someone help me find a Breath Of Flame flower?

It's burdock root season!
Could someone bring me one?

I'm making my favorite Onion Soup, but I seem to be short on the most important ingredient.
Could someone bring me an Onion?
A Capital merchant with a high opinion of himself recently told me I couldn't expect something like Golden Butter out of Mistria. I'll pay handsomely to prove him wrong.
A Roasted Sweet Potato is especially good when the weather starts to turn cold. Can I request a Sweet Potato?
A few ears of Grilled Corn would be a perfect summer side dish. Could someone grill them up for me?
Grilled Corn is a regular side at our dinner table, but I don't want to dip into our shop's stock. I'd like to request 4 ears of corn.

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Olric asked me to meet him at the Bathhouse to help him with a "super normal" situation.

tables.title: Requests
rows: Diamonds have a lot of industrial uses, but I just like'em cause they're shiny! Hard to find though, could someone bring me one?

When the earthquake hit, we lost a lot of our gear in the mines.
I found my pickaxe, but Errol never found his. I'd love to return it to him!
Request for a Really Round Rock

I once saw an incredibly round rock in the mines, but it rolled out of sight before I could grab it!
If you see it, could you bring it to me?
Hi, can someone bring me a cool rock? I'm collecting them! I'll give you a nice chair in exchange.
Can I request a Pike? I hear fish is brain food, and I've never caught a pike so I figure they're pretty smart!
March never really liked Oyster Mushrooms when he was little, but maybe now that he's older he'll like them! Could someone find some for me?

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Seridia asked me to meet her at her temple to discuss something privately. Does she want me to pay homage again?
Seridia said she's been craving an Ice Cream Sundae. Anything to help her out!

tables.title: Requests
rows: There seems to be a type of Rockclod that possesses the remarkable ability to spit Bombs. I would like one. A Bomb, that is.
I require a Dragon-Forged Core, to test out fluctuations in this era's ley lines.
Have you heard of a Fire Wasp? It sounds delightful! I would like to request one.
I wish to try the popular new drink called the "Latte".
I would like to request the dessert known as "Mont Blanc".
I may have punched a teeny tiny hole in space-time. I'd like to request 3 Void Stone. Quickly, please.
I would like to request a Butterfly. Please take extra care, I am told they are quite delicate.

Have Met Seridia
Current Season: Spring

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Reina asked me to come by the Inn when possible to try out a new dish of hers.
Reina asked me to join her in the General Store. She's on the hunt for ingredients to wow the judges of the cooking competition.
Reina says she has something important she needs to ask me. I wonder if she's heard more about the Cooking Competition...
It's time! This is Reina's big moment in front of the judges for the Aldarian Cooking Contest.
Reina said she's been craving an Ice Cream Sundae. Anything to help her out!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
I'm working on a pie recipe, but I need some fresh wild berries.
If you bring me some I'll teach it to you!

It's blueberry season, so I want to make some blueberry jam!
If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe!

Can I request some fresh broccoli?
There's a tough recipe I want to try out...

Anyone in the mood for a little ocean fishing?
I'm looking for a Cod, and I've got a recipe to share if you do!

Luc wants to see a bug he's never seen before!
Can you help me be a cool big sister and find an insect from deep in the mines?

I've been experimenting with ice cream recently, and that takes a lot of milk!
Bring me some and I'll let you try out one of my recipes!
I think my Rosemary might be getting a bit old, could someone bring me a fresh sprig now that it's back in season?

Could someone bring me a wild leek? I'm a little short for my soup recipe.
I'll give you a bowl to take home in return!

Could someone please bring me some garlic?
Since garlic is in season, I'd love to make a batch of garlic bread. If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe!
Any Chef will tell you that the one thing they can never have enough of is Butter! I'd like to request some.
Luc told me about Deluxe Honey and how only a hive of rare bees can make it! I'd love to try cooking with some!

tables.title: Important Quests
rows: Ryis asked me to meet him to review crafting.
Letter from Ryis on Year 1, 10 Spring

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows: Landen asked me if I had any spare wood on the farm. He said to bring him 15 pieces for 150t!
Ryis wants me to meet him in his room to talk about a new tree for the cottage ruins. One step closer to a new birdhouse!
Ryis says the tree is ready for a birdhouse and asked me to come over to build it. What color should we paint it?
Ryis says he spotted a blue feather by the birdhouse. I should meet him at the Hawthorn tree for some bird watching!

rows:

Can you help?

This chilly weather has me craving a taste of home.
If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe for cranberry orange scones!
Looking for someone to gather Glowberries for me, I'd like to make some cookies.
I'm slightly short on materials for a project. Can anyone spare some wood and stone? I can pay, of course!
My parents really like Mistrian Smallmouth bass. Can I request a couple to send them?

rows: Terithia asked me to meet her at her shack to tell me about The Big One.

tables.title: Requests
rows: I could use a little extra help getting the fish to bite. Can someone bring me a worm?

Don't know if it's found around these parts, but I'm looking for an Earthshroom.
I got a recipe to exchange for it that'll make it worth the hunt!

It's salmon season again, and I'm craving some horseradish salmon!
If someone can bring me some key ingredients, I'll share my recipe!

I'm craving some smoked trout soup, but the fish aren't biting for me!
If you can bring me a trout I'll teach you my recipe!

I like seaweed fine in a cooked dish, but not too much by itself.
Maybe I just haven't tried the right kind. Bring me some I haven't tried before!
I've got a craving for Tuna Sashimi, but I just haven't had any luck with my catches! Can someone help out?
You ever heard of the Coelacanth? They say it's a fish that's been around for pretty much forever. I've never caught one, but I'd love to see one!
Little Luc was telling me that those new Terrariums thingies can produce Common Bait that helps attract fish. I'm not much for taking care of bugs, so I'd like to request one!

tables.title: Heart Quests
rows:
It's time for YOUR free annual check-up! Yes you, the person reading this.
Come to Valen's Clinic today for a healthier you!
Valen asked me to bring her one piece of peat for her research. I hope it's not for flavoring her medicine...
Valen is struggling with her research into the panacea and wants to get Juniper's help. This might be tricky...
Valen asked me to meet her at the Western Ruins to search for the Cliffblossom. There are a lot of cliffs there, so hopefully it'll turn up...
Valen said she's been craving a Grilled Cheese. Anything to help her out!

tables.title: Requests
rows:
Would someone please bring me some herbs?
I'm planning to make some herb salad but I'm a little short on ingredients.

I would like to source a morel mushroom, as it's known to have anti-inflammatory properties.
Please deliver one if possible.

I would like to request some fresh rose hips so I can make some seasonal jam.
They can be found fruiting on rose bushes when the weather gets cold.
If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe for rose hip jam!

Would someone please deliver some seaweed?
This hot weather calls for a nice chilled seaweed salad. If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe!

My favorite tea has been in short supply for ages now.
Could I request some local tea instead?
I woke up to birdsong yesterday morning and quite enjoyed it. I'd like to request a Birdhouse to hopefully attract some new bird friends to my Clinic.
One of the joys of summer is fresh Cucumbers. Could I request a few?
I'm a bit of a Honey connoisseur, recently I read about a special Premium Honey but I can't seem to find any. Little help?

tables.title: Requests
rows:
As the name suggests, Winter Stew is just the thing for a frosty day in Mistria!
Bring me a Daikon Radish and I'll share my recipe with you.

One of my favorite herbs in Mistria is the Sesame!
Bring me some and I'll show you a great dish to make with it.
Can I request a glass of Pomegranate Juice? There's nothing more refreshing!
I'd like to request a Riceball, I need something I can eat while working.
Can anyone in Mistria make me a Salted Watermelon? It's a perfect summer treat!
